verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI's own docs describe an official 'Docs MCP server' that coding agents can connect to for mid-session documentation lookups, and a probe confirms it is documented. Its documented scope is limited to doc lookup, not the transcription or speech APIs, and the evidence is thin. Missing for 10: an MCP server exposing product capabilities (transcription/streaming) as tools, documented endpoint and setup instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Docs MCP server ... Devs whose agent does heavy mid-session doc lookups.
